from pathlib import Path
import json,os,subprocess,time,hashlib
root=Path('<corpus>')
baseline=json.loads((root/'baseline.json').read_text())
assert len(baseline['entries'])==23
exe=baseline['build']['nativeExecutable']['path']
expected=baseline['build']['nativeExecutable']['sha256']
assert hashlib.sha256(Path(exe).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==expected
report=root/'report.json';assert not report.exists()
env=os.environ.copy();env['PFDSL_ACCEPTANCE_ROOT']=str(root)
log=(root/'execution.log').open('w')
process=subprocess.Popen([exe],env=env,stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
lifecycle={'pid':process.pid,'executableSha256':expected,'reportExists':False,'exitBeforeCleanup':None}
code=1
try:
 start=time.monotonic()
 while not report.exists() and process.poll() is None and time.monotonic()-start<90:
  time.sleep(.2)
 lifecycle['exitBeforeCleanup']=process.poll();lifecycle['reportExists']=report.exists()
 assert report.exists(),'Native corpus did not produce report; inspect execution.log'
 result=json.loads(report.read_text())
 print('result keys',list(result),flush=True)
 print('native report',json.dumps({k:v for k,v in result.items() if k in ['passed','failures','errors','execution']},ensure_ascii=False),flush=True)
 assert result['passed'] and not result['failures'] and not result['errors']
 print('results',len(result['results']),flush=True)
 assert len(result['results'])==23
 code=0
finally:
 if process.poll() is None:
  process.terminate()
  try:process.wait(timeout=10)
  except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:process.kill();process.wait(timeout=10)
 lifecycle['exitAfterCleanup']=process.returncode
 log.close()
 (root/'lifecycle.json').write_text(json.dumps(lifecycle,indent=2)+'\n')
 print('owned process cleanup',json.dumps(lifecycle),flush=True)
raise SystemExit(code)
